research_query: What are the economic impacts of AI on the labor market?

search_results.title: AI Report 2025
search_results.content: AI adoption has grown 50% since 2020 across enterprises. Key areas include customer service automation, document processing, and predictive analytics.

search_results.title: Jobs and AI Study
search_results.content: Routine cognitive tasks are most at risk. Administrative assistants, data entry clerks, and basic accounting roles face the highest displacement risk.

search_results.title: AI Creates Jobs Too
search_results.content: For every job displaced by AI, 1.3 new jobs are created in AI development, maintenance, and adjacent fields. The net effect may be positive.

key_findings: Routine cognitive tasks are most affected

research_query: How effective are current carbon capture technologies?

search_results.title: CCS Technology Overview
search_results.content: Direct air capture (DAC) can remove CO2 at $250-600 per ton. Post-combustion capture from power plants operates at $40-120 per ton.

search_results.title: Scaling Carbon Capture
search_results.content: Current global CCS capacity is approximately 45 million tons per year, far below the gigatons needed to meet climate goals.

key_findings: Multiple carbon capture methods exist with varying costs
Current capacity is far below what is needed
